title: Psychological distress, family-related factors and self-management in children with type 1 diabetes: a mixed-methods study
summary: This study investigates psychological distress, daily self-management, and family-related factors in children with type 1 diabetes. Children and their parents will complete standardized questionnaires. In addition, interviews with parents will be conducted to better understand family-related influences. The aim of the study is to gain insights that may help improve psychosocial support for children with type 1 diabetes and their families.

interventions.name:
In this prospective, non-interventional study, standardized questionnaires are administered once at the time of study participation to children with type 1 diabetes.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosed type 1 diabetes mellitus
Age 8–18 years
Written informed consent from parents/legal guardians
Age-appropriate assent from the child
Exclusion criteria:
Severe psychiatric disorders
Insufficient language proficiency without access to professionally translated study materials
Lack of informed consent
